name: vending
description: Dispenser furniture: `vend` pulls a data-driven item (flags.vends) from a machine in the room, drops it in your bag, and coughs a line to the room. A machine carrying flags.vend_drink offers the row it just made to plugins/drinks, which fills the vessel and charges for it — so an espresso rig makes the cup AND the coffee. Free institutional food and the like; reusable for any dispenser.

vend.note: A declaration-only specializedAction with requiredFlag 'vends' surfaces VEND on examine and in the room pane's action list. This was filed as a KNOWN GAP for a long time on the grounds that availableActions cannot read flag VALUES — true, and beside the point: requiredFlag gates on the flag KEY, which is all a dispenser needs.

extensionPoints: A new dispenser is content: furniture flags.vends (the item id), plus flags.vend_line and flags.vend_cooldown_s.

A dispenser that FILLS what it hands over adds flags.vend_drink. This plugin knows nothing about what a drink is — it offers the new inventory row to drinks.serveVended and prints whatever comes back.
notes: The fill seam is guarded on getRegisteredActions() because dispatchAction answers an unregistered type with an ERROR object rather than silence — an unguarded dispatch would turn every plain dispenser into a refusal the day drinks was unloaded.

A refusal from the fill (you cannot afford it) DELETES the row that was just inserted and leaves the cooldown unarmed, so a machine that would not serve you has not taken your cup back with one hand and locked you out with the other.
